title: Archimedes Banya

services.name: Banya Guide
services.desc: Upon arrival, all guests must check in at the front desk. If you haven’t already done so, you must purchase a Banya pass. This pass is mandatory, regardless of whether or not you have booked any other services. We offer a variety of passes at different prices, depending on the day and time of your check-in. To see the pricing options in more detail, please click here. When you arrive at the Locker Room, please locate your assigned locker by matching the number on your wristband. Simply place your wristband next to the lock and it should open. Inside, you will find two towels and a pair of flip flops, provided for your use during your visit. services.name: Rooftop Yoga
services.desc: Energize your body through moving meditation on our rooftop with bayside views of San Francisco, Oakland, and the Bay Bridge. Rooftop Yoga is free with your banya pass and is the perfect way to compliment your day of relaxation and restoration at Archimedes. We offer a variety of yoga and meditation practices including vinyasa, kundalini, and sound healing. Classes are held on Sunday at 12noon and are clothing optional. Please check the Calendar for more classes. Free with Banya

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: We can accommodate groups of up to 40 guests during our regular operating hours and offer complete facility rental for up to 100 guests outside our regular operating hours. Our small and large venue rooms each feature comfortable seating, flat screen televisions, and dining seating.
